Definition: Sallu or Sallai, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Sallu or Salu or Sallai = "weighed"; 1) a priest in the time of Zerubbabel; 2) father of Zimri, the prince of the Simeonites, who was slain by Phinehas; 3) a post exilic Benjamite
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
